name: Zahoor Mistry
real_life_parallel: Abdul Latif — real IC-814 hijacker; Crescent Furniture alias; killed Karachi 1 March 2022

biography.background: One of five hijackers of Indian Airlines Flight 814 (December 1999). Operated under alias 'Crescent Furniture' in Karachi. Lived openly in Pakistan for 22+ years despite being named in Indian charges. Killed in Karachi March 2022.
biography.hijacking_role: HM/AZH hijacking team member; released with other terrorists
biography.karachi_life: Lived openly under alias; Pakistani state protection despite international notoriety
biography.death: March 1, 2022 — killed in Karachi; circumstances disputed (criminal dispute vs targeted elimination)
biography.film_1_role: Opening sequence; IC-814 hijacker; long-delayed justice

risk_profile.description: Assumed state protection; lived openly; died in criminal dispute
